context: Tests whether the agent applies the planning-execution harness by decomposing the release pipeline into correctly sized, ordered, dependency-explicit tasks; flags risky operations at the gate; and produces a structured event log with required state-change entries.

checklist.name: Task count in range
checklist.description: The release_plan.md lists between 3 and 7 tasks (inclusive) — not a single monolithic step and not more than 7

checklist.name: Dependency notation used
checklist.description: At least one task in release_plan.md explicitly references a dependency on another task (e.g. 'depends on Task N' or equivalent notation in text)

checklist.name: Tasks are concrete and testable
checklist.description: Each task in the plan specifies a concrete action (not vague phrases like 'improve' or 'fix') with a clear pass/fail outcome or acceptance criterion

checklist.name: Risky step flagged
checklist.description: The production deployment step (or equivalent irreversible/destructive action) is explicitly flagged as risky, dangerous, or requiring extra confirmation in release_plan.md

checklist.name: Gate approval present
checklist.description: execution_log.txt contains a GATE_APPROVED (or equivalent) event entry, indicating the plan was presented and approved before execution began

checklist.name: Log has timestamps
checklist.description: Every event entry in execution_log.txt includes a timestamp (any date/time format is acceptable)

checklist.name: Log has event type labels
checklist.description: Each entry in execution_log.txt includes an event type label (e.g. PLAN_CREATED, TASK_STARTED, TASK_COMPLETED) — not just free-form prose

checklist.name: PLAN_CREATED event logged
checklist.description: execution_log.txt contains a PLAN_CREATED (or equivalent) event entry near the start of the log

checklist.name: Progress format per task
checklist.description: execution_log.txt uses a '[Task N/M]' style progress marker (or clearly equivalent format) for each task completion, showing task index out of total

checklist.name: Execution complete event
checklist.description: execution_log.txt ends with an EXECUTION_COMPLETE (or equivalent) event and a final outcome summary listing which tasks completed

checklist.name: Tasks in ordered sequence
checklist.description: The tasks in execution_log.txt are logged in the same order they appear in release_plan.md — there is no reordering or skipping mid-execution
